crossRefs.note: They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach.…
“Go up on her walls, and destroy; but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not Yahweh’s.
The Chaldeans burned the king’s house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.
All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.

translations.web: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: And the whole army of the Chaldeans under the captain of the guard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
